builds.name: Big damages
builds.desc:
This build is meant for a more offensive Sumia. While she has impressive defense with her vanilla setup, this build aims to use her impressive speed to turn her into an offensive powerhouse.
Harmonic Lance+ and Moonbow are used to make up for her low attack. Moonbow's fast charge time works perfectly with Harmonic Lance+ damage boost.
Reposition is pretty much used in every flier build and this build is no different.
Swift Sparrow 2 gives Sumia a stronger player phase, but Fury 3 is a good budget option that improves her bulk and helps her reach Desperation 3 range.
Desperation 3 is the best offensive B skill to use as it allows her to double nearly every other hero with impunity once she's low enough. Atk/Def Link 3 is the more defensive and budget option to use, but works well enough.
Hone Fliers allows Sumia to buff her flying teammates to saucy levels. Guidance 3 can help her more grounded allies jump around and be a nuisance.
